title: Coffee with a friend
subtitle: Practise a relaxed conversation about faith at a café.

missionary.label: Missionary
missionary.sceneText: You are meeting a friend you know from a community event. They are already at a table.
missionary.goal: Have a friendly conversation and ask what they believe.

christian.label: Christian
christian.sceneText: You are having coffee and waiting for a friend you know from a community event.
christian.goal: Share what you believe in your own words.

interactionTrigger.initiatorPrompt: You see your friend walk into the café.
interactionTrigger.receiverPrompt: Your friend waves at you from a table.

openingDialogue.script: Thanks for meeting me! I've been looking forward to catching up.
openingDialogue.listenerPrompt: Greet your friend and chat for a moment.

questions.title: What is your church like?
questions.missionaryScript: I didn't know you went to church. What's your church like?

christian.hint: Mention something you value about your church.
christian.hiddenAnswer: Share one or two things you appreciate, such as the teaching, the people, or how it helps you follow Jesus.

followUps.label: Ask why it matters
followUps.missionaryScript: Why is going to church important to you?

christian.hiddenAnswer: Church is where I worship God with other believers, learn from the Bible, and serve others.

questions.title: How do you read the Bible?
questions.missionaryScript: Do you read the Bible much? How do you know how to understand it?

christian.hint: Think about reading each passage in its context.
christian.hiddenAnswer: I read it regularly and try to understand each passage in its context. I trust it as God's word.

conclusion.closingPrompt: Thanks for the coffee. Let's do this again soon.
conclusion.reflectionPrompt: Which question was hardest to answer, and why?

sourceNotes: Sample scenario that exercises a non-doorstep trigger started by the Christian.
